name: arrayReduce
description:
Iterates over every entry of the given array and calls the closure with every element. 
This function will reduce the array to a single value and will return the value.
syntax: arrayReduce( array array, function closure, [object initialValue] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
function/closure that implements the following constructor

`function(any result, object value, [, numeric index [, array]]){ return result; }`

params.name: initialValue
params.description: initial value passed as part of the first closure call
